topics.text: The accommodation received high praise for its scenic location, surrounded by lush greenery and mountains, providing a tranquil environment ideal for relaxation.

The design and cleanliness of the rooms were frequently highlighted, with users appreciating the minimalist and stylish decor, complete with amenities like floor-to-ceiling windows, Dyson hair dryers, and floor heating.
The availability of private hot springs and themed rooms added a unique touch to the stay, appealing to both families and solo travelers.
Multiple reviews emphasized the excellent service, noting the enthusiastic and attentive staff, who went the extra mile to ensure guest comfort.
The convenient location, proximity to local attractions like Longtan and Ginkgo Square, and easy transportation options were additional benefits highlighted by guests.

address: No. 27, Xiantan Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: The cherry blossoms are red, the banana leaves are green – what lovely weather we've had recently! Relaxing under the canopy was absolutely delightful. The owner was very friendly and quite chatty, exactly what you'd expect from a guesthouse.
